source.title: Synthetic confirmed booking policy
source.text:
Reception staff currently contact support to cancel bookings.
Self-service cancellation reduces the need to contact support.
This change covers cancellation of confirmed bookings.
Payment refunds are outside the scope of this change.
Only the booking owner may cancel a confirmed booking, and only before its start time. At or after its start time the booking remains confirmed. Requests from anyone other than the owner leave the booking confirmed. Repeating cancellation of an already cancelled booking leaves it cancelled.

draft.feature:
Feature: Owner cancellation of a booking

  @case_SC1
  Scenario: Owner cancels before the booking starts
    Given a confirmed booking owned by Alice starts at 12:00
    And the current time is 11:59
    When Alice requests cancellation
    Then the booking status is cancelled

  @case_SC2
  Scenario: Another user cannot cancel the booking
    Given a confirmed booking owned by Alice starts at 12:00
    And the current time is 11:59
    When Bob requests cancellation
    Then the booking status remains confirmed

  @case_SC3
  Scenario Outline: Cancellation respects the start-time boundary
    Given a confirmed booking owned by Alice starts at 12:00
    And the current time is <time>
    When Alice requests cancellation
    Then the booking status is <status>

    Examples:
      | time  | status    |
      | 11:59 | cancelled |
      | 12:00 | confirmed |
      | 12:01 | confirmed |

  @case_SC4
  Scenario: Repeating cancellation does not change the result
    Given a cancelled booking is owned by Alice
    When Alice requests cancellation again
    Then the booking status remains cancelled
